name: world kit: six walking instruments in the emulator (task 01.2.3)

steps.label: the arc and a pool of six instruments hang in the arc root
steps.eval: (async () => { const t = await import('/src/kit/world/time.ts'); const p = await import('/src/kit/world/path.ts'); const k = await import('/src/kit/world/instrument.ts'); t.installKit(app.world, clock); const path = p.createPath(); app.roots.arc.add(path.root); path.setPlan(['s1','s2','s3','s4','s5'].map((id) => ({ id, step: 'read', label: id, by: 'code' }))); const pool = k.createInstruments(app.world); app.roots.arc.add(pool.root); window.__kitPerf = { path, pool, t, before: perf.info() }; return true; })()

steps.label: six instruments walk back and forth with loads and lit rings
steps.eval: (() => { const { path, pool } = window.__kitPerf; const all = ['page','cards','spool','slips','pencil','page'].map((kind, i) => { const it = pool.spawn('extractor', 'perf-' + i); it.carry(kind, i === 0 ? '1–6' : undefined); return it; }); const walk = () => all.forEach((it, i) => it.moveTo(i % 2 ? path.spot('s4', i % 4) : path.spot('s2', i % 4))); walk(); window.__kitPerf.timer = setInterval(() => all.forEach((it, i) => it.moveTo(path.lane(i % 2 ? -25 + i : 20 - i))), 1400); return pool.lit(); })()

steps.label: the instruments zone draws with at most six calls
one frame of the pool costs under 0.5 ms (mean of 600 updates while walking)
steps.eval: (() => { const { pool } = window.__kitPerf; const n = 600; const t0 = performance.now(); const now = clock.now(); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) pool.update(now + i * 11); return (performance.now() - t0) / n; })()
